title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
keywords: How to write a report 2.How to grasp the purpose 3.How to consider 4.logical thinking
educationalGoal: This course takes over from “Basics Style for Study A and B” and aims to develop reporting skills in specialized fields. In the process of discovering and solving problems, it is necessary to have the ability to summarize and share information on your thoughts and claims in reports. In order to acquire this as an “individual” ability, students will learn the procedure for writing reports on themes in line with the specialty of their chosen department. The course will provide an introduction to the writing of reports and papers for specialized subjects.
advice: In order to cultivate the basic abilities of “grasping the purpose”, “organizing information”, “thinking logically”, “reporting in writing”, and “distinguishing between plagiarism and citation”, students learn the procedure for writing reports. Reports will be based on information collected on themes according to the specialty of the department to which the students belong and reference articles will be used to write reports. The goals of the course are to: 1. Understand the concept of papers in psychology. 2. Understand the purpose of the psychological experiments and organizing the results to create a logical description of the considerations. 3. Learn the expressions used and the types of papers and reports in psychology. The course is linked to the contents of the “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments” course which will be held in the same semester. Students are required to make use of what they learned in the both courses. The progress of classes will be adjusted as needed according to the level of understanding of students and the progress of assignments. Note: Since this is a one-credit course, there are some weeks when there are no classes. The specific class schedule will be provided in the first class.
requiredKnowledge: Improve your reading and writing skills in “Basics Style for Study A and B”. Be familiar with the how to use the library center, which is necessary for information collection, and how to use the Internet.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand the meaning of psychological experiments and describe their purpose clearly.
Ability to describe the results and considerations of psychological experiments logically.
Ability to write reports that follow a standard format in psychology.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will be able to acquire the basic abilities of “grasping the purpose”, “organizing information”, “thinking logically”, “reporting in writing”, and “distinguishing between plagiarism and citation”. Students will be able to fully grasp the purposes of experiments and write convincing reports with logical considerations based on the obtained results.
achievementLevels.standard: Students will be able to acquire the basic abilities of “grasping the purpose”, “organizing information”, “thinking logically”, “reporting in writing”, and “distinguishing between plagiarism and citation”. Students will be able to grasp the purposes of experiments and write reports with logical considerations based on the obtained results.
